stage: Adds Cmax and t1/2 from the same Table 2 for the Digital human 1.1d time-course check (lenalidomide_body_map_time_course_plan_v1.json, secondary endpoint), recorded before that comparison was computed. AUC24 values unchanged from v1.

source.citation: Bridoux F et al. Cancer Chemother Pharmacol 2016;78:173-182.
source.location: Table 2, 'Plasma lenalidomide pharmacokinetic parameters by renal group' (page 177)

statistic_quote: Data shown are median (range) for Tmax and geometric mean (geometric CV) for other parameters

exposure_measure.chosen: AUC24 on day 5 (plan endpoint rule 1: the AUC the article compares between groups; also rule 3)
exposure_measure.definition: area under the plasma concentration-time curve from time zero to 24 h after dosing, non-compartmental
exposure_measure.severe_footnote: Estimated as average daily AUC (AUC48/2), since the dose was given every other day

esrd.regimen: 5 mg once daily (after haemodialysis on dialysis days)
esrd.note: descriptive only; not simulated (neither model has a dialysis process)

reference_group: normal renal function (Table 2 does not pool normal and mild)
n_note: The n in the Table 2 header equals the enrolled n of Table 1 in every group.
also_in_table_not_used: Tmax, CL/F, Vz/F (not named in either plan).
